Index master (CLUT-free, one per page, 8 px/texel = the 2048 export grid): per-index soft weights.  For every native index i the
one-hot mask is upsampled texel-centred (bilinear), gaussian-smoothed (sigma, texels) and raised to a power, then normalised; the
master keeps the top-K labels and weights per pixel (u8).  Any CLUT renders it: RGB = weighted mix of the CLUT entries of the
visible labels; alpha either 'soft' (visibility = weight of visible labels >= 0.5, class of the strongest visible label) or
'native' (the native class map, nearest).  Then the native class is forced at every native texel centre floor((i+0.5)*scale)
(one pixel each) and validated (0 mismatches).
Recipes (all CPU, deterministic, no AI, nothing added):
  planet    sigma 0.90, power 1.0, top-4, alpha native: the limb pages are ordered-dithered tone images with stippled
            (alternating transparent column) fades; a linear soft mix of the visible labels turns the dither into continuous
            tone (motion-safe); the stipple columns are the native class map (they cannot become partial alpha: classes are
            categorical).
  explosion sigma 0.45, power 1.5, top-4, alpha native (w2-effects FX contract: alpha = native class map, RGB free); per frame
            cell the light energy of every preview render is checked against native (0.95-1.05).
  hulls     sigma 0.30, power 4.0, top-3, alpha soft (w4-world catsoft: plateaus keep exact native colours, stair steps
            become smooth contours).
